column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Luca and Juda's Retreat
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: That is far enough!
A-ah... w-w-wait!! W-who was that just now?!
D-don't tell me...?!
Is that $$ガイ$$ going to pop up behind us again?!
Do not panic so easily!
Even if that brat is alive, he adds only one more unit of $$戦力$$.
Besides, the rest of them are already in tatters! We win by weight of numbers!!
This minor accident will not affect the outcome!!
Hahahaha... Will it really go as smoothly as you have calculated?!
T-that armor?!
Oh? You had best take a good look around you too!
D-damn it!!
Tch! Until the $$勝利の賢者$$ are assembled, we cannot risk a free-for-all gamble.
It seems our only option is a strategic retreat.
There is no need for concern. My $$残酷・邪道騎士団$$ is
already prepared.
Heh. Very good.
Yes!!
We shall withdraw for now and increase our $$戦力$$!
You will take that man...
Understood.
Oh, $$ダーリン$$!
It is a shame, but farewell for now... Do your best!!
